item.text: {"search_note":"I found no reliable 2024 evidence of Kishida or close family profiting through private assets, gifts, bribes, emoluments, opaque foundations, or direct business favoritism. The closest related material is the LDP funding scandal and the prior 2023 son/residence misuse story, but neither gives clean 2024 proof of Kishida-family financial enrichment.","evidence":[{"title":"Press Conference by Prime Minister Kishida","publisher":"Prime Minister’s Office of Japan","date":"January 4, 2024","url":"https://japan.kantei.go.jp/101_kishida/statement/202401/04kaiken2.html","summary":"Kishida said the LDP would cooperate with prosecutors, created a Political Reform Headquarters, and invited external experts to design transparency rules for political funds. This is strong negative evidence that hidden money and unreported proceeds existed in Kishida’s governing party environment.","question_ids":["7B.4"]},{"title":"Prosecutors indict several LDP faction members over funds scandal","publisher":"Kyodo News","date":"January 19, 2024","url":"https://english.kyodonews.net/news/2024/01/f4d6ea5b7d8f-update1-prosecutors-indict-several-ldp-faction-members-over-funds-scandal.html","summary":"Prosecutors indicted multiple people from ruling-party factions, including a former accountant from Kishida’s group, over a slush-fund scandal involving roughly 500 million yen in undisclosed revenue.
